mission.title: Death and Demons
mission.description: Trade a decrypted dossier for the location of the Demon Army's leader.

phase.briefing: {player}. It is good to hear from you. We have decrypted the data you captured from the Demon Army, but even decrypted, it is a gibberish of words and phrases that are meaningless to us. However, they probably have significance for the street gangs you are dealing with. Pick up the decrypted dossier from our contact, Agent Norris.

enter.say: Agent Norris should be in there.

objective.text: Get the dossier from Agent Norris

talk.say: You are {player}. Agent Gray requested that I give you this dossier. Please take it.

phase.briefing: It is known that the group of Exiles in Moriah Projects calling themselves the "Crossbones" is currently at odds with the Demon Army. The Crossbones are rumored to be lead by a program named "Hatchet." Locate Hatchet and trade him the dossier in exchange for the location of the Demon Army's leader.

enter.say: The Machines said that a Crossbones gang hangs out in that building, and the number of Exile programs I'm detecting in there seems to bear that out. We need to impress upon them the advantages inherent in not pissing us off.

done.say: Get that note from him, operative.

objective.text: Get the note from the Crossbones Thug

done.say: I've scanned the address. I'll put it up as your next waypoint once you get outside.

phase.briefing: We calculate that Hatchet will be willing to cooperate once he understands that it is to the Demon Army's disadvantage, ergo to his advantage, to do so. We trust that you will make this sufficiently clear to him.

enter.say: That's the address. I'm scanning a good number of Exile programs inside.

talk.say: *cough* Information captured from the Demon Army? This had better be good. Let me see.
Give him that dossier. Hopefully it's something he can use...

done.say: Hah. Haha-- *cough cough* Ugh. Sorry. Looks like you've played me square, operative. I'll loan you two of my best bully-boys to go rough up Mammon, the Demon Army leader, if you think you can really get past his guards. They'll point the way. Good luck to you.
I guess he liked it. Two strong Exile signals just showed up in a room close to you. Collect his two henchmen and lead them outside.

phase.briefing: The Demon Army leader is named "Mammon." He must either have the case, or have delivered it to someone else. Remember, operative, that locating the case is absolutely imperative.

enter.say: I've got a single Exile signal in there. Mammon?

talk.say:
My spies told me you were coming, heretic. And I will tell you what you wish to know: Cacophony. That is the name of the contact who provided us with the equipment, and who arranged to collect the case. I never saw his face.
And now that you know that, you will die. Demons! Arise!

done.say: Cacophony? Doesn't ring a bell. I guess we shou-- Uh-oh. You've got company.

mission.finish: Cacophony? We will scan our data banks. It is possible that Mammon provided false information in order to get you to leave. We will know soon enough.
